description: This source file contains an extension for the CronJobEditor class, providing helper functions for UI rendering, data hydration, payload construction, validation, and scheduling related to cron jobs within the application. It includes methods to build and validate payload data, handle session targets, and parse duration strings.

methods.name: gridLabel
methods.description: Creates a styled Text view label for the UI with secondary foreground styling and fixed width.

methods.name: hydrateFromJob
methods.description: Populates the editor's properties from a given CronJob object, setting UI states accordingly.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Builds payload data and triggers save action or handles errors.

methods.name: buildPayload
methods.description: Constructs a serializable payload dictionary representing the cron job configuration for submission.

methods.name: buildDelivery
methods.description: Builds delivery options as a dictionary, considering channel, to, and effort flags.

methods.name: trimmed
methods.description: Removes whitespace characters from the start and end of a string.

methods.name: requireName
methods.description: Ensures the name field is non-empty; throws an error if not.

methods.name: buildSchedule
methods.description: Creates a schedule dictionary based on schedule type and associated data.

methods.name: buildSelectedPayload
methods.description: Generates the payload portion based on current payload type.

methods.name: validateSessionTarget
methods.description: Validates consistency between session target and payload type, throws errors if invalid.

methods.name: validatePayloadRequiredFields
methods.description: Ensures required fields for specific payload types are filled, throws errors if not.

methods.name: applyDeleteAfterRun
methods.description: Sets deleteAfterRun flag in the payload depending on schedule kind and properties.

methods.name: buildAgentTurnPayload
methods.description: Builds a payload dictionary for agentTurn payload type, including message, thinking, and timeout.

methods.name: parseDurationMs
methods.description: Parses human-readable duration strings into milliseconds.

methods.name: effectiveSessionTargetRaw
methods.description: Returns the raw session target string, preserving specific raw value if session target is isolated.

methods.name: isIsolatedLikeSessionTarget
methods.description: Checks if the effective session target is not 'main' indicating an isolated-like job.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a concise string.
